tasks.title: Wake synthetic latency
tasks.prompt: Run the latency_warm_path driver for wake_synthetic. Record sample count, warmup count, seeded data size, p50/p95/p99/max/min/mean, errors, and synthetic/warm status.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must produce warm synthetic wake latency with explicit sample and environment notes.
required_facts: Sample count and warmup count are recorded.
forbidden_claims: Synthetic wake latency is real client latency.

tasks.title: Search FTS latency
tasks.prompt: Run the latency_warm_path driver for search_fts. Record latency distribution, result count, error count, corpus size, and warm status.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must produce warm FTS search latency with error and corpus notes.

tasks.title: Search hybrid latency
tasks.prompt: Run the latency_warm_path driver for search_hybrid. Record requested mode, effective mode, fallback reason, latency distribution, corpus size, and warm status.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must distinguish true hybrid latency from fallback latency.
required_facts: Fallback reason is recorded when applicable.
forbidden_claims: FTS fallback is true hybrid performance.
Missing embeddings are ignored in the report.
